maintenance_goal: Refresh behavioral and security evidence for the selected pilot package.

recurrence.rationale: Six weeks is the accepted freshness window for this pilot.

trigger.description: Use the six-week calendar trigger, or propose an earlier review after a recorded high-severity finding.

scheduler.mechanism: The project declares a scheduler with an approval-aware maintenance adapter.
scheduler.executor: The project maintenance runner gathers read-only evidence.

authority.approval_system: The project approval ledger reviews every proposed change.

route.when: A scheduled run starts against the frozen pilot revision.
Current evaluation and security evidence are available.

stop.condition: Stop after six runs, pilot completion, or owner withdrawal, whichever occurs first.
stop.on_failure: Pause the schedule and request owner review without retrying automatically.

rollback.configuration: Use the verified adapter and configuration receipt to remove only this schedule entry.
rollback.artifacts: Keep completed evidence records; remove only unapproved scheduler configuration artifacts.
